checks.name: valid quote binds exact catalog, selection, destination, shipping, scope, and currency terms
quote IDs are deterministic for identical inputs and response timestamps
known zero remains distinct from an unknown price component
included unknown tax is preserved while a reconciled total remains exact
known included tax may be positive or zero but cannot exceed the inclusive total
zero-decimal and three-decimal currencies reconcile without floating-point arithmetic
provider response rejects unmodeled per-line currency fields
amount precision beyond the declared currency scale is rejected
a mismatched provider total fails exact reconciliation
missing inputs and stale snapshot selections fail before quotation
unsupported personalization and removed catalog products never invoke the quote port
catalog snapshot freshness expiry blocks quotation
provider expiry and conservative local expiry remain distinct
expired provider quotes and unknown total cannot pass the quote boundary as usable terms
quote timeout aborts the bounded quote request and never submits an order
per-port rate limit rejects excess quotes before invoking the provider
provider errors expose only bounded safe messages
forged, subclassed, accessor-backed, proxy, and input errors are projected to owned diagnostics
provider notes and contract payloads reject sensitive data
boundary privacy accepts structurally bound timestamps and exact large money while rejecting personal and secret text
getter-backed input and provider responses are rejected without invoking accessors
missing or malformed quote schema pins fail closed before the quote port
contract pin metadata rejects private or unbounded text before quote execution and accepts opaque pins
validated numeric SKU and spaced trusted scope stay current through a substantive mapped boundary
all creation-approved numeric catalog identifiers round-trip through mapped output and unchanged currentness
matching numeric identifiers do not exempt phone-like provider notes or unbound boundary fields
changed catalog, selection, destination, shipping, or quantity requires re-quote and renewed external authorization
expired quotes require a fresh quote and renewed external authorization
current-quote evaluation rejects inconsistent serialized money, terms, expiry, and future creation
